text: Yes, all days of the period (2026-10-01 to 2026-10-08) were checked for thermal detections on this property. The latest evidence (version 2) confirms that all four sensors (VIIRS_SNPP, VIIRS_NOAA20, VIIRS_NOAA21, and MODIS) covered the entire period without gaps. No thermal detections were found intersecting the asset during this time. The earlier version (version 1) had a temporal gap due to data not being published yet, but this was resolved in the updated version.
